text:
Marta: Hey team, Prospect " + "Neptune Health" + " asked for a quick benchmark sprint this week to validate sustained concurrency and short bursts for their triage workflow. They want: 200 concurrent users, typical prompt len ~120 tokens, peak bursts to 800 concurrent for ~30s. Can we run a focused test and a small cost estimate? :eyes:
Dan S.: I can run the test on our staging pool. Quick q: do they want hosted API numbers or Dedicated-reserved estimates?
Marta: They prefer hosted first (to move fast) but will need Dedicated if SLA/certs check out. Please include both cost slices.
Ashley: Re: load profile — we should include warmup + steady + burst phases. My draft:
- 5m warmup ramping to 200 concurrency
- 15m steady at 200
- 3x bursts to 800 for 30s spaced 2m apart
- 10m cool-down
Also we should prime prefix cache for the common system prompt.
Oliver: For metrics capture: p50/p95/p99 latency (generation time + setup), error rate, GPU utilization, queue depth, and tail CPU/RAM on the worker. Also track KV cache hit rate and token throughput (tokens/s).
Dan S.: I’ll prepare the load script using vegeta/wrk-proto. Example run command I plan to use:
```bash
wrk -t16 -c800 -d00:23:00 --latency \
  -s scripts/openai_like.lua --  https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-13b-q4_0","prompt":"<system>triage</system>...","max_tokens":120}'
```
I’ll swap model param for the quantized variant and the fp16 for a Dedicated run.
Marta: can you also capture per-request token cost so we can produce a $/1M token estimate?
Dan S.: Yep. I’ll log tokens_in/tokens_out and multiply by hosted pricing. For Dedicated, use our reserved cost model and include amortized infra.
Ashley: Small perf gotcha: cold-starts on model shards will spike latency for first 10-20s after a scale-up. We should exclude the initial 30s of each burst from tail numbers or at least annotate them. Also ensure the autoscaler cooldowns are set to 60s so we actually observe scale behavior.
Marta: Security question: Neptune asked about KMS + audit logs and whether hosted keys are OK. They mentioned SOC2 and an upcoming vendor review. We should note that Dedicated will give them customer-managed KMS and longer audit retention.
Oliver: I’ll attach a short runbook for the test and the dashboards to monitor:
- metrics.redwood.internal/dash/prospect/neptune
- bench-bot will post summary when done.
bench-bot: Scheduled run: 1777006000, lane: staging-small, expected duration: 00:30:00. Results will be uploaded to the thread when ready. :robot_face:
Dan S.: One more pricing ask from sales: show delta if they enable prefix caching + 2x batching. I’ll compute token cost reduction using measured tokens/s and hypothetical batching factor (1.6x).
Marta: Great. Who owns the writeup for the customer-ready deck? We need the summary + one-slide cost table + one-slide reliability notes.
Ashley: I’ll draft the perf writeup and include the p95/p99 plots, resource charts, and a short recommendation: "Hosted for pilot; Dedicated for SLA and KMS."
Marta: Perfect. If anything blocks test access (keys, IP allowlist), ping me immediately.
Dan S.: noted. I’ll start the job now and update the thread after the run.
bench-bot: Run started at 1777006000. Job ID: run-neptune-1777. Streaming logs -> https://logs.internal/run-neptune-1777
Marta: Thanks all, appreciate the quick turn. :thumbsup:
